newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's forex policy has not changed -- Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: Japan's forex policy has not changed -- Sakakibara.

text.p: Japan's policy on foreign exchange has not changed, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, told reporters on Thursday.
Japan welcomes the developments in the currency markets since April 1995, Sakakibara said.
Cooperation among the Group of Seven industrialised nations on currencies remains unchanged, he added.
Asked about the strength of Japan's economy, Sakakibara said: "The economy is neither strong nor weak."
Sakakibara quoted U.S. Treasury Undersecretary Jeffrey Shafer as saying the Clinton administration supported a strong dollar.
